svg.metadata: OpenStreetMap coastline ways, ODbL 1.0, retrieved 2026-11-15. Mainland: ways 22335558, 1558284973 and 673063895 joined at shared node IDs; offshore islands include ways 195334955 (Prickly Pear East), 195340661 (West), 195370662 (Sandy Island), 22871487 (Dog), 22636920 (Scrub), 25220044 (Sombrero), 24762572 (Scilly Cay), and associated mapped islets. WGS84 local-equirectangular-fit-v1, 1200x760. Full mainland coastline is repeated unchanged at uniform 2x scale in a detail inset. No inferred shoreline. Visible inland water: OpenStreetMap water ways 45202248, 522228932.
